title: Hemorrhoid treatment (surgery)
what: A colorectal surgeon removes or ties off swollen hemorrhoids. There are several methods, from placing small bands without anesthesia to surgery with pain relief.
why: When hemorrhoids come out, bleed, or hurt a lot, and creams, suppositories, and diet no longer help.
duration: the procedure usually takes 15 minutes to 1 hour; sometimes you go home the same day, after surgery usually 1 to 3 days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you ever had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a bowel check. Your clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Bowel
prepare.text: Usually you have a cleansing enema or drink a solution the evening before and in the morning, as your doctor plans.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: If you will have general or spinal anesthesia, usually no food from the evening before. Your clinic will give you the exact time.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: If you need stronger pain relief than local, an anesthesiologist will talk with you.

bring: Things for 1 to 3 days in hospital
steps: You change your clothes. If needed, a thin tube is put into a vein
You get pain relief: local, an injection in the back, or general anesthesia, as chosen with your doctor
You lie on your back with your legs raised, or on your side
The surgeon removes or ties off the hemorrhoids
If needed, a gauze pad with ointment is placed in the back passage
You are moved to your room and watched
feel: There should be no pain during the procedure
Afterwards, pain and burning in the back passage, especially in the first days. You will get pain medicine
The first bowel movement is often painful. This is expected
After banding, a feeling of fullness can last 1 to 2 days
after: Soft stools are very important: more water and fiber, and a laxative if your doctor prescribes it
Warm sitz baths and washing after each toilet visit, as your surgeon advises
A little blood on the toilet paper in the first 1 to 2 weeks can happen
Do not lift heavy things or sit for long in the first weeks
Healing usually takes 2 to 6 weeks, depending on the method
red_flags: You cannot pee for more than 6 to 8 hours
Fever, chills, or pain that gets much worse: see a doctor right away or call emergency services

faq.q: Does it hurt after hemorrhoid surgery?
faq.a: Yes, there is pain for the first days, especially on the toilet. Pain medicine helps, and soft stools and sitz baths make healing easier.

faq.q: Can hemorrhoids be treated without surgery?
faq.a: In early stages, often yes: diet, creams, bands, or injections. A colorectal doctor decides which method suits you after an exam.

reminders.text: Hemorrhoid procedure tomorrow. Check your bowel prep plan and the time of your last meal.
Time for your bowel prep, as your clinic planned. If you will have anesthesia, usually no food after midnight.
